name: glitchr/omnilab
description: Omnilab: one contract for the public science-data APIs - entities (a compound, a gene, a protein, a species, a star, an earthquake) with their properties, units and cross-references, series (a variable measured at a place over time: weather, climate, air) and catalogued products (a satellite scene, a dataset, STAC-like) - whatever the domain; a Collector that follows cross-references from one base to the next, and a Symfony bundle.

suggest.omnilab/pubchem: PubChem: compounds by CID, name, InChIKey, CAS or SMILES, their computed properties, synonyms, structure image and cross-references
suggest.omnilab/open-meteo: Open-Meteo: hourly and daily weather series at a point, forecast and historical archive
suggest.omnilab/copernicus: Copernicus Data Space: Sentinel, Landsat and Copernicus service products from its STAC catalogue
suggest.omnilab/chebi: ChEBI: chemical entities by ChEBI id, InChIKey, CAS, KEGG or name, their structure, ontology (classes, roles) and cross-references
suggest.omnilab/wikidata: Wikidata: any item by Q-number, by a science base's identifier or by label, its labels in a language, its cross-references and a few properties with units
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnilab\Bridge\Symfony\OmnilabBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnilab\Bridge\Symfony\OmnilabBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnilab\Bridge\Symfony\OmnilabBundle itself
